An '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At the time when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was executed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], he was part of a group of eight padawans that fled the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] and were traveling across the [[Shinarcan Bridge Extension]] and attempting to pass through the checkpoint and escape [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but their chances failed when they were caught by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] personnel, which led to a shootout. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], who was also passing through on her way to a join up with the rest of [[Clan Skirata]] for evacuation, stepped in front of the padawan to protect a clone trooper, who panicked and struck her down by accident. Seconds afterward, he was stabbed fatally in the chest by [[Darman Skirata|Darman]].
